address: 10 Seymour Place, Marylebone, London, W1H 7ND, United Kingdom
bio: Perch at the counter or sit at one of the tables in this fun, warmly run little spot and enjoy a selection of pintxos and tapas inspired by the food of San Sebastián. House specialities such as gilda, bacalao and txuleta are always worth ordering. Just one dessert is offered, but when it’s Basque cheesecake as wonderfully creamy as this, who would want anything else?...
